name: Lantern Market
description: Lantern Market, a free night-market tile game you play in your browser.
heroTitle: Clear the counter before the lanterns go out.
heroText: A night-market puzzle about jewel tiles, hungry patrons and a hotpot belt that never stops. One game takes about 20 minutes, on a phone or a computer.

enquiry.title: Send feedback
enquiry.intro: Found a bug, or have an idea for the market? Send it here.

questions.question: Does it cost anything?
questions.answer: No. It's free, with no ads and no sign-up.

questions.question: Does it save my game?
questions.answer: Yes, in your own browser. Close the page and your market is still there when you come back.

questions.question: What's the daily market?
questions.answer: A market that's the same for everyone on the same day, so you can compare scores with friends.
